metadata.scenario: A prospect calls asking for a quote on landscape design services for their new home. Category: New Inquiry. Outcome: quote_provided. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi, Margaret. This is William Chen. I'm a current client, but I have a question about landscaping services. I'm glad to hear from you, William! However, we only offer home healthcare services, not landscaping. Oh, I see. I thought you might offer more services since you provide care at home. I understand the confusion. We specialize in skilled and non-skilled healthcare, like physical therapy and personal care. Got it! I’m actually looking for some help with my knee recovery and physical therapy. We can definitely assist with that. Just to confirm, you started your care plan three weeks ago, right? Yes, that's correct. My last visit was two days ago. Great! If you're looking for ongoing physical therapy, Dr. James Rodriguez is our specialist. Can you tell me more about what that would involve and the pricing? Sure! Physical therapy sessions are priced between $110 to $140 for a 45 to 60-minute session. That sounds reasonable. How often would you recommend I have sessions? Typically, we recommend at least two to three sessions per week for optimal recovery after surgery. That would fit my schedule. Should I coordinate with Dr. Rodriguez directly for booking? Yes, you can reach him directly at +13165559215 to schedule your sessions. Thanks! I’ll reach out to him. Also, I might need some personal care assistance soon. We can provide personal care assistance for activities like bathing and grooming. What’s the pricing for that? Personal care assistance ranges from $28 to $35 per hour, depending on the level of care required. That sounds good. I’ll think about it and let you know when I’m ready. Perfect! Would you like me to set up a follow-up call to check in on your needs next week? Yes, please. That would be helpful. Great! I'll call you next Monday at the same time. Thanks, Margaret. I appreciate your help! You’re welcome, William! Have a great day, and take care! You too! Bye! Bye!
